research_cycles.hypothesis: A deterministic label is training-safe only when the evaluator can reconstruct the label-bearing state/evidence subjects from authority external to the mutable candidate row, including exact producer/source/policy identity and immutable ordered history.
research_cycles.counterhypothesis: For a fully closed deterministic synthetic world, a compact exact generator invocation plus reconstructed subjects may be sufficient without carrying a separately materialized event-history proof object.
discriminator: same event_id with different semantic content must fail
co-mutate candidate content and candidate-carried digest must fail
reconstruction from authority-pinned generator plus ordered inputs must reproduce exact expected subjects
research_cycles.project_effect: Do not weaken the current nonempty-history producer-authority P0. Machine-actionable lineage supports the project direction, but external standards do not by themselves prove Clay's specific gate; exact mutation execution remains required.

research_cycles.hypothesis: Epistemic type must gate evidence admission before u_state mutates E_plus/E_minus/F/sigma; UNKNOWN/HYPOTHESIS/PREDICTION/MEASUREMENT_ERROR must remain non-evidence unless a typed authority converts them through an admitted observation/proof process.

discriminator: hold world/outcome constant while permuting epistemic_type
require non-evidence types to leave evidence-bearing state unchanged
require OBSERVED to carry authenticated producer/result identity
require SYNTHETIC_PROOF to remain bound to exact generator/proof authority
preserve UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN as a first-class correct outcome rather than forcing resolution

external_research.finding: NIST frames provenance as documented origin and alteration history and emphasizes identifiable authoritative copies and reproducibility.
external_research.project_implication: Supports exact source/version/alteration lineage and reproducible reconstruction as research-data discipline.

external_research.finding: Counterfactual causal and neutral augmentations can improve robustness to spurious reward-model correlates; robust design requires interventions that separate causal attributes from non-causal surface signal.
external_research.project_implication: Strengthens full-cross/conditional-independence and semantic-ablation nuisance gates; random presentation alone remains insufficient.

external_research.source: Shafran et al., From Directions to Regions, arXiv:2602.02464
external_research.finding: Reported activation concepts can exhibit nonlinear, multidimensional local geometry that isolated global directions miss.
external_research.project_implication: Do not encode Global J-Space as one universal linear direction by assumption.

external_research.source: Raval et al., Curveball Steering, arXiv:2603.09313
external_research.finding: Reported concept-dependent geometric distortion can make nonlinear steering outperform global linear steering.
external_research.project_implication: Require geometry-family competition under the same causal controls if the final checkpoint does not support linearity.

external_research.source: Dong and Shinnou, Uncertainty-Aware Abstention, arXiv:2607.04430
external_research.finding: Risk-controlled selective answering can calibrate abstention thresholds on held-out data rather than treating raw confidence as truth.
external_research.project_implication: Supports explicit UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN evaluation and held-out calibration; does not transfer its guarantees automatically to Clay's training distribution.
